cards.ex: That old building is a death trap; they should tear it down.
cards.exUz: O'sha eski bino o'lim tuzog'i; uni buzib tashlashlari kerak.
cards.uzDef: Juda xavfli joy, unda o'lish oson bo'lishi mumkin.

cards.ex: He's flirting with danger by driving that fast on a wet road.
cards.exUz: U ho'l yo'lda bunchalik tez haydab xavf bilan o'ynashmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli ish qilmoq, lekin oqibatlari haqida o'ylamaslik.

cards.ex: The city's debt is a ticking time bomb; it's going to explode eventually.
cards.exUz: Shaharning qarzi soatli bomba; u oxir-oqibat portlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Vaqt o'tishi bilan portlashi mumkin bo'lgan vaziyat yoki narsa.

cards.ex: If he's caught cheating on his taxes, he'll be in deep water.
cards.exUz: Agar u soliq to'lashda aldaganlikda ayblansa, u katta muammoga tushadi.
cards.uzDef: Katta muammoga tushib qolish, qiyin ahvolda bo'lish.

cards.ex: You're playing a dangerous game by not telling him the truth.
cards.exUz: Siz unga haqiqatni aytmasdan xavfli o'yin o'ynamoqdasiz.
cards.uzDef: Juda xavfli yoki noaniq oqibatlarga olib kelishi mumkin bo'lgan ish qilmoq.

cards.ex: Their marriage is on shaky ground after the affair.
cards.exUz: Ularning nikohi xiyonatdan so'ng nozik vaziyatda.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli vaziyatda, ishonchsiz, qulay emas.

cards.ex: That project is too hot to handle; I don't want to be involved.
cards.exUz: Bu loyiha ishga yaroqsiz; men aralashmoqchi emasman.
cards.uzDef: Juda xavfli, qiyin yoki noqulay vaziyat.

cards.ex: They've reached a point of no return in their negotiations.
cards.exUz: Ular muzokaralarda qaytish yo'q nuqtasiga yetishdi.
cards.uzDef: Ortga qaytib bo'lmaydigan vaziyatga yetib kelish.

cards.ex: If sales keep going south, we'll have to lay off staff.
cards.exUz: Agar sotuvlar yomonlashishda davom etsa, biz xodimlarni qisqartirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyat yomonlashmoqda, muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchramoqda.

cards.ex: He's playing with fire by investing all his money in that startup.
cards.exUz: U barcha pulini o'sha startapga investitsiya qilib, olov bilan o'ynamoqda.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli ish qilmoq, o'zingizni xavfga qo'ymoq.

cards.ex: The company is on the brink of bankruptcy.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya bankrotlik yoqasida.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir yuz berishi mumkin bo'lgan oxirgi holatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: The manager is in the firing line after the company's poor performance.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning yomon natijalaridan so'ng menejer tanqid ostida.
cards.uzDef: Tanqid yoki xavf ostida bo'lish, xavfli vaziyatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: He got burned trying to flip houses; he lost a lot of money.
cards.exUz: U uylarni sotishga urinib kuyib qoldi; u ko'p pul yo'qotdi.
cards.uzDef: Tajribasizligi tufayli muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchrash.

cards.ex: We're going to have to bite the bullet and raise prices.
cards.exUz: Biz o'qni tishlashimiz va narxlarni oshirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Og'riqli, lekin zarur bo'lgan narsani qabul qilish.

cards.ex: That old bridge is a disaster waiting to happen.
cards.exUz: O'sha eski ko'prik tez orada yuz berishi aniq bo'lgan falokat.
cards.uzDef: Tez orada yuz berishi aniq bo'lgan falokat.

cards.ex: He walked into a trap when he agreed to meet them alone.
cards.exUz: U yolg'iz uchrashishga rozi bo'lganda tuzoqqa tushdi.
cards.uzDef: O'zing bilmagan holda xavfli vaziyatga tushib qolish.

cards.ex: By threatening to quit, she raised the stakes in the negotiation.
cards.exUz: Ishdan bo'shatish bilan tahdid qilib, u muzokaralarda xavfni oshirdi.
cards.uzDef: Risklarni yoki xavf darajasini oshirish.

cards.ex: He's skating on thin ice with his boss after being late so many times.
cards.exUz: U ko'p marta kech kelganidan keyin xo'jayini bilan muzda uchmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli vaziyatda bo'lish, xato qilish imkoniyati yuqori.

cards.ex: The election is on a knife-edge; it could go either way.
cards.exUz: Saylov pichoq tig'ida; u har qanday tomonga ketishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Natija juda noaniq bo'lgan vaziyatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: Many small businesses went belly up during the pandemic.
cards.exUz: Pandemiya davrida ko'plab kichik bizneslar bankrot bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchrash, biznesdan chiqib ketish.

cards.ex: The country's economy is teetering on the edge of recession.
cards.exUz: Mamlakat iqtisodiyoti retsessiya chegarasida muallaq turibdi.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli vaziyatda bo'lish, qulab tushish xavfi ostida.

cards.ex: They're pushing the envelope with their new marketing campaign.
cards.exUz: Ular yangi marketing kampaniyasi bilan chegarani kengaytirishmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Xavfni qabul qilib yangi narsalarni sinab ko'rish.

cards.ex: He's sticking his neck out by supporting that controversial policy.
cards.exUz: U o'sha bahsli siyosatni qo'llab-quvvatlab bo'ynini cho'zmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli ish qilmoq, tanqidga duchor bo'lish.

cards.ex: It's a shot in the dark, but we might as well try it.
cards.exUz: Bu tasodifiy urinish, lekin biz uni sinab ko'rishimiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: G'alaba qozonish imkoniyati past bo'lgan urinish.

cards.ex: Many people fall prey to scams online.
cards.exUz: Ko'pchilik odamlar onlayn firibgarliklarga qurbon bo'lishadi.
cards.uzDef: Nimagadir qurbon bo'lish, ta'siriga tushish.

cards.ex: His actions are sowing the seeds of future conflict.
cards.exUz: Uning harakatlari kelajakdagi mojarolarning urug'ini sepmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakda yuz berishi mumkin bo'lgan muammoni yaratmoq.

cards.ex: He faced a court-martial for disobeying orders.
cards.exUz: U buyruqlarga itoat qilmagani uchun harbiy sudga duch keldi.
cards.uzDef: Harbiy xizmatchiga nisbatan o'tkaziladigan sud.

cards.ex: The factory was fined for illegally dumping hazardous waste.
cards.exUz: Fabrika xavfli chiqindilarni noqonuniy ravishda tashlagani uchun jarimaga tortildi.
cards.uzDef: Odamlar va atrof-muhit uchun xavfli bo'lgan chiqindi.

cards.ex: You've already won once; don't push your luck.
cards.exUz: Siz allaqachon bir marta g'alaba qozondingiz; omadingizni sinamang.
cards.uzDef: O'zingga omad kulib turgan paytda haddan oshib ketish.

cards.ex: The city is a powder keg of racial tension.
cards.exUz: Shahar irqiy ziddiyatlarning porox bochkasidir.
cards.uzDef: Tezda portlashi mumkin bo'lgan xavfli vaziyat.
